text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers check each other's code before it is added to the project, they can catch bugs early, when they are easier and cheaper to fix. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from reading each other's work and discussing different solutions. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by making sure everyone follows the same standards and good practices. Although code reviews take time, they are worth the effort. They reduce mistakes, improve communication, and help the whole team grow stronger together.
